package blackjack_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/db"
	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/secret"
)

func TestWritePreviousEightSeatFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	directory := os.Getenv("NONBIRI_NINE_SEAT_FIXTURES")
	if directory == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing fixture directory")
	}
	for _, phase := range []string{"seating", "decision", "result"} {
		t.Run(phase, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newFixture(t, 10)
			for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
				f.join(i)
			}
			if phase != "seating" {
				f.clock.Store(135)
				f.read(0)
			}
			if phase == "result" {
				f.clock.Store(165)
				f.read(0)
			}
			h := f.read(0)
			if h.Table == nil || len(h.Table.Fact.Seats) != 8 || h.QueueCount != "2" {
				t.Fatal("eight-seat source fixture mismatch")
			}
			f.recovery()
			if _, err := f.db.Exec(`VACUUM INTO ?`, filepath.Join(directory, phase+".db")); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPreviousBinaryRejectsNineSeatUpgrade(t *testing.T) {
	directory := os.Getenv("NONBIRI_NINE_SEAT_FIXTURES")
	if directory == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing fixture directory")
	}
	vault, err := secret.New(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x41}, secret.MasterKeyBytes))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer vault.Close()
	for _, phase := range []string{"seating", "decision", "result"} {
		path := filepath.Join(directory, phase+"-upgraded.db")
		before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		store, err := db.Open(path, vault)
		if store != nil {
			store.Close()
			t.Fatal("old binary accepted nine-seat schema")
		}
		if err == nil {
			t.Fatal("expected old binary rejection")
		}
		after, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil || sha256.Sum256(before) != sha256.Sum256(after) {
			t.Fatal("old binary modified new data", err)
		}
		for _, suffix := range []string{"-wal", "-shm"} {
			if _, err := os.Stat(path + suffix); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Fatal("rejection created sidecar", suffix, err)
			}
		}
	}
}
